about: World view evaluation (v4 backend plan, 13.7). Labelled on Oct 26, 2026, before any run, and never tuned on. Each question is asked of the test fixture Brain seeded by scripts/world_eval.py (relationships, a superseded day rate, a dispute and dated decisions). `expect` is any-of: an answer is correct when it contains one of the terms (case ignored); `expect_all` needs every term. Run two ways: with the world view (main), and without it (the code from just before section 13).
